name: Posture
author: Edgars Mjasnikovs
description: Watches your sitting posture through the webcam and shows why it drifted from your own good-posture slate.

schema.label: Leaning in
schema.description: Alert when your head comes closer to the screen than your slate.

schema.label: Head drop
schema.description: Alert when your head sinks toward your shoulders (slouching).

schema.label: Head tilt
schema.description: Alert when your head tilts to one side.

schema.label: Side lean
schema.description: Alert when your shoulders tilt (leaning to one side).

schema.label: Alert after (seconds)
schema.description: How long bad posture must last before the card shows.

schema.label: Side monitors
schema.description: ignore: looking at a side screen is not judged. perMonitor: record a slate for each monitor.
